assertions.name: bring_plus_faddeev_h4_m_p_within_500ppm
assertions.source: Bring color-tube + Faddeev h⁴ correction (best composition) predicts m_p within 500 ppm of CODATA at MPFR 50 dps. The underlying categorical claim — Faddeev recursions at two substrate-natural z values — is RULE 14 COMPLIANT (both factors live in the 13-driver menu).

description: Probe of the combined Bring color-tube + Faddeev h⁴ form for linking_weight(q). Per the h⁴ categorical-driver probe, two of the 13 drivers converge on +1·h⁴ as the leading correction: (i) Faddeev iterated `1/(1−h⁴) − 1` and (xiii) KLR positivity (smallest non-trivial non-negative integer). Both are Faddeev functional-equation ratios at substrate-natural z values (z_1 = h·q^10 for Bring color-tube; z_2 = h⁴ for KLR canonical-basis). Tests three composition rules — additive, multiplicative, bring-only — at q_0 against CODATA m_p, m_n.

parameters.interpretation_z_1: 10 = 9 color-pair assignments (3 colors × 3 colors) + 1 diagonal direction (per Bring color-tube weighted averaging, Phase 5q open finding)
parameters.interpretation_z_2: h⁴ = substrate-natural KLR canonical-basis vector at H_4 partition algebra (KLR positivity: smallest non-trivial non-negative integer = 1)
